description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Array', which represents an array type in XML-RPC encoding within the Zend Framework. It extends a collection class and provides methods for initializing with an array value and generating corresponding XML.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Array
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC array value, capable of generating its XML representation and storing an array of values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an array value and sets the type to XML-RPC array.

methods.name: _generateXml
methods.description: Produces the XML representation of the array value following XML-RPC specification.
